name: prove-it
description: The fix must make a test fail first: reverts your source changes, runs the changed tests and requires a failure, restores (verified by hash) and requires a pass. Optional gate on git push and gh pr create.

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: The command that runs tests, with the changed test files appended as arguments (no shell), e.g. "npm test --", "pytest" or "go test". Runs at the repository root.

testGlobs.title: Test file globs
testGlobs.description: Comma-separated globs (relative to the repository root) that mark a changed file as a test.

sourceGlobs.title: Source file globs
sourceGlobs.description: Comma-separated globs for the files that make up the fix. Empty means every changed tracked file that is not a test.

base.title: Base branch
base.description: The ref the change is measured against (its merge base with HEAD). Empty means origin's default branch, then origin/main, origin/master, main, master.

gate.title: Gate push and PR
gate.description: Run the proof before git push and gh pr create, and refuse them unless the fix is proven. /prove skip lets the next one through.

timeoutSeconds.title: Test timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one test run may take before it counts as an error (at most 600).
